album pages: centred hero, Play/Shuffle capsules, numbered rows

player position polled at 1 s instead of 200 ms behind other apps

one-time offer (and a Settings row) to lift Android battery optimisation, a frequent cause of music apps being slowed or stopped by the phone

known_limitations: Lyrics are searched on the device only for titles whose lyrics Ketvoice has already shown (up to 1500 titles); other titles need a sentence of three words or more and Genius.
Radio draws on the catalogue's similar artists and on YouTube Music search; for little-known artists it may repeat the same few artists.
The battery offer is shown once; Android may still restrict apps on some phones (vendor task killers).
The rubber-band effect applies to lists that use Compose's overscroll; a few custom scrollers keep their old edge.
Ket 27 stays an alpha: several pages keep Ketvoice's own structure.
A manual skip is still a plain change of title: it is not mixed.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
